corroboration.note: NSRL and CIRCL hashlookup presence, antivirus non-detection, and VirusTotal detection counts are corroboration only. They identify known files or generic labels; they never form the basis of a NO, and a generic HackTool or RiskWare count never forms a PROVEN YES. A PROVEN service-based YES needs a specific family on record or family convergence plus locally proven behaviour.

proof_standard.yes_proven: Malicious capability or behaviour proven in context: a capability chain (stealer, injection plus payload, download-and-execute, persistence plus command and control, miner, ransomware pattern, backdoor, rootkit hiding), a scope test failure (the first behaviour unnecessary for the claimed function decides it), antivirus tampering, Safe Mode manipulation or reboot-count gating (the Crackonosh pattern), a known-bad family hash hit, or an unaccounted executable difference that carries a proven malicious chain. An unneeded remote download-and-execute capability is itself malicious class.
proof_standard.yes_unaccounted: Any byte, file, script, archive layer or behaviour that could not be accounted for as genuine or as the explained crack: an unopened or password-protected archive layer, a virtualized region, an unaccounted diff region, an executable that is not part of the genuine program, a compiled binary with no reference, no valid signature and no identified crack patch, or generic-only service detections that need behaviour evidence. UNACCOUNTED is stated plainly as unaccounted, never as proven malware.
proof_standard.no: Every file byte-identical to a genuine signature-valid original (hash match or reference-manifest hash equality), or a fully reverse-engineered difference classified expected-crack or benign-repack in the diff ledger, with all archive layers unpacked to the bottom. Phrased exactly as the accounting claim: Every byte is accounted for as genuine or explained crack, and no behaviour beyond the genuine program plus the explained crack was observed in the evidence. This verdict is linked to the evidence manifest in this report.
proof_standard.circumvention: Circumvention itself is not malware: patched checks, keygen algorithms, KMS emulation (local emulator service, renewal task, GVLK keys), and hosts-file activation blocks are the expected crack. Antivirus HackTool or CrackTool labels alone never trigger YES.
